fusions.name: Mana Nibble
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of arcana at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Mana Siphon] for 6 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Raw Surge
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone of arcana that deals 28 damage to everything in it, ignoring resistances. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Siphoned Draught
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Overflow
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
